about_the_game:
What Is It?

Anima Codex is your world building and story telling companion!

An intuitive tool designed for Writers, Gamemasters and Creators who want to bring their universe to life!

Who's it for?

  • Novelists and Writers - Keep track of Characters and their Personalities!

  • Game Developers - Keep track of NPC's, different factions and World Settings!

  • Dungeon Masters - Sick of writing notes by hand? Use Anima Codex to keep track!

  • Creative Thinkers - Draft Worlds and more and see what sticks!

Features:

  • World Builder - Create and Describe your Worlds

  • Factions Creator - Make Nations and Countries in your Worlds

  • Location Manager - Describe Regions, Cities and Landmarks in as much detail as you desire

  • Character Profiles - Track relationships, personalities, roles and much more

  • Item Library -  Document relics, tools and artifacts important to your setting

  • Quest Editor - Create Quests, with Rewards, Objectives and More

  • Notes - For making General Purpose Notes

  • Inspector - Easy and simple to use inspector loading system

Other Features:

  • Tagging System - Easily Apply Tags to everything in the inspector

  • Searching - Have alot of Characters? Simply Use the search bar to filter them out

  • Images - For each file, you can add an image that is displayed above the content. Great for Displaying Maps or Character Portraits

  • BBCode - Supports Basic BBCode, allowing you to create Tables, Bold, Font Sizes and more!
